def solution():
    # Define variables and values
    principal = 300_000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.045
    years = 30

    # Calculate total payments using the fixed-rate mortgage formula
    monthly_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_payments = years * 12
    monthly_payment = principal * monthly_rate / (1 - (1 + monthly_rate) ** -number_of_payments)
    total_cost = monthly_payment * number_of_payments

    # Return the total cost rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(total_cost)
